title: Meme Management
description: Manage AI memes - import, edit semantic metadata, search and statistics

filter.searchPlaceholder: Search title, caption text, description, or tags...

detail.title: Edit Meme
detail.name: Name
detail.namePlaceholder: e.g., Pouting hands on hips, Let's eat first
detail.descriptionPlaceholder: Describe the subject, facial expression, gesture, and atmosphere...
detail.ocrTextPlaceholder: Leave blank if there is no text in the image
detail.emotionTagsHint: Prefer fine-grained cues, e.g., disgusted, guilty, pouting
detail.usageHintPlaceholder: Good for expressing ... in chat (use positive contexts only)
detail.enabledDesc: When off, AI will not retrieve or send this meme while keeping it in the library
detail.personaHintPlaceholder: For display only. It does not choose what is sent.
detail.retagConfirmDesc: Trigger VLM recognition immediately and overwrite semantic fields. Online memes remain usable until updated. Continue?
detail.deleteConfirmDesc: Are you sure you want to delete this meme? This action cannot be undone.

upload.title: Import Assets
upload.dragDrop: Drag and drop files here, or click to select files
upload.dragDropHint: Supports JPG, PNG, GIF, WebP images and .meme archives
upload.autoTagDesc: Automatically trigger VLM semantic recognition after upload
upload.skipExistingDesc: Skip already existing memes when importing .meme files
upload.targetPersonaDesc: Default is Common. Select an existing pack or create a new one to place all uploaded files into it.
upload.newPackHint: Type a name and upload directly to create the pack and put all files into it
upload.newPackNameRequired: Please enter a new pack name

purgeRejectedConfirmDesc: This will permanently delete all memes with 'Rejected' status, including source files, database records and vector indexes. This action cannot be undone.
purgeAllConfirmDesc: This permanently deletes memes (source files, database records and vector indexes) and cannot be undone. Choose the clear scope.
purgeFilteredNoFilter: No status/folder/persona filter is active. Apply a filter or choose “Clear ALL”.
batchRetagPendingConfirmDesc: This will re-add all 'Pending Manual' memes to the VLM tagging queue. Continue?
batchRetagIncompleteConfirmDesc: Run VLM completion for untagged memes and records missing new semantic fields. Manually filled fields are preserved and online memes stay usable. Continue?
batchRetagIncompleteConfirmPackDesc: Run VLM completion for incomplete memes inside pack “{pack}”. Manually filled fields are preserved and online memes stay usable. Continue?
batchRetagSkippedFull: Queued {count} memes; skipped {skipped} because the queue is full
batchRetagSelectedConfirmDesc: Run VLM recognition for {count} selected memes and overwrite their semantic fields. Online memes stay usable until updated. Continue?
noMemesDesc: Upload some memes to get started
batchDeleteConfirmDesc: Are you sure you want to delete {count} selected memes? This action cannot be undone.
batchExportNoSelection: Please select memes to export first
exportDotMemeDesc: Choose one sticker pack, or export all. A chosen pack puts only its images in the archive.
importDotMemeDesc: Idempotent restore from .meme archives produced by the server.

import.title: Import Memes
import.dragDrop: Drag and drop .meme file here, or click to select file
import.skipExistingDesc: Skip already existing memes during import
import.autoTagDesc: Trigger VLM recognition for newly imported memes
